_README: MACHINE-READABLE ROSTER VERDICTS (phase 179). The screening verdicts used to live ONLY as prose
in qa-boss/anchors/MK-FINAL-WAVE2-SCREEN.md, so no tool could read them and every filesystem-based
survey missed them. That failed FOUR times: nurikabe-shield (caught mid-write), kira-foxflare (a
full kit was written and committed for a REJECTED character), umbra-jelly (agent stopped), and
drake-glaive (agent stopped). The prose ledger even carried a warning about this exact failure.
The prose file remains the reasoning of record. THIS file is the machine-readable index of it,
and qa-boss/may-i-write-kit.mjs is the guard that reads it. Keep them in sync: when you add a
verdict to the prose, add it here in the same commit.
status: OK          = screened, viewed, cleared to write a kit
REJECTED    = do not write a kit; reopening is a DECISION, not a fresh measurement
TIM         = gated on Tim's ruling; do not write a kit unilaterally
UNVIEWED    = numbers are clean but nobody has LOOKED. 50% of numerically-clean plates
fail the view, so this is NOT permission — view it first.
Anything absent from this file is treated as REFUSED by the guard, deliberately: 'not in the
reject list' must never be readable as 'approved'.

kira-frostveil.why: Viewed phase 184. BAKED MIST/VAPOUR rendered into the character — her paired sai are translucent ICE with visible vapour streaming off the blades. That is the banned effect class rendered into the plate, the exact ground that rejected Ghast Flail (baked smoke/mist around the base). It also explains her 11.49 translucency, the highest of the unviewed set: the WEAPONS themselves are see-through, so they will fringe badly and may partially key away. Body is also quite open to camera.

skeleton-nodachi.why: DOUBLE COLLISION, viewed phase 184. WEAPON: nodachi and odachi are the SAME weapon (大太刀), so it collides with the SHIPPED satoshi-odachi — the exact ground that rejected Tengu Naginata (same weapon as raiju-naginata). CREATURE: skeletal undead, colliding with lich-scythe. Secondary: bare bone limbs, individual finger bones and split lower-leg bones are all thin fringe-prone struts, and p99 13.2 was already the highest of the unviewed set.

ningara-silk.why: Viewed phase 184. COSTUME IS THE DECISIVE GROUND, and it is not technical: a sheer lace lingerie bodysuit, stockings and high heels — a pin-up render, tonally incompatible with a roster of armoured samurai, knights and creatures. Also, independently: the sheer lace is GENUINELY translucent across the whole torso (this is what the measured 7.67 will-fringe was detecting — real see-through fabric, not a green-dominant confound); high heels give no stable ground contact for the feet-flat beats every kit requires; and the spear collides with the SHIPPED sora-yari.

kitsune-tanto.why: THE BLOCKER DID NOT MATERIALISE — needs a canonical-look ruling, not a re-screen. Its PLATE carries a live yellow-green blade glow (5.28% emissive, the highest in the roster, and the character the "kitsune blocker" class is named after). But the 13 RAWS ON DISK DO NOT REPRODUCE IT: the raw frames show plain steel before any keying, so the model never rendered the glow. Consequence, all measured phase 183: the clips key CLEANLY (soft fur tails crisp, blade intact and not carved into, residual greenExcess mean -35, p99 0, 0.00% hot), and they agree with their own plate BETTER than accepted clips do (idle .920/.917, strike_a .937/.938 vs lich strike_a v3 ACCEPTED at .902/.905; ko .370/.347 is expected since he collapses). So they are technically shippable. THE ONLY OPEN QUESTION IS A DESIGN ONE: the plate shows a glowing blade and every clip shows plain steel, so the canonical look is inconsistent between the still and the animation. Tim rules on which is canonical. NOTE these raws predate the 3-role start/end/image transport, so a RE-FIRE today would pin the glowing plate at f0 and might reintroduce the hazard the existing raws happen to dodge.
